main_text.p: stare. الغلاة autem seu ifti, licet in aliisdi-versum sentiant, unanimiter tamen statuunt التناسخ μετενσωμάτωσιν[?] & الحلول i. e. explicante AlSharestanio ان الله تعالى قايم بكل مكان ناطق بكل لسان ظاهر بشخص من اشخاص البشر Esse Deum in omni loco, loqui omni lingua, atque apparere in persona aliqua individua. Inde asseruerunt eorum nonnulli esse Antistites انبيا ثم الهة Prophetas, deinde Deos.Ibid.

AlNosairii] Hos cum Isacianis conjungit AlSharestanius, sed unde appellati sint, ( ut in reliquis solet sectis) non docet, tantùm dicit esse ipsos ex eorum numero qui modum excesserunt, atque esse ipsis جماعة ينصرون من هم turbam quae sectam eorum adjuvaret seu promoveret. Num inde forsan nomen hoc fortiti sunt? Dicunt hi pro concesso habe-ri ظهور الروحاني بالجسم الجسماني apparere substantias spirituales in corporibus crassioribus, sic aliàs Angelos, alias diabolum apparuisse. Asserunt ergo &ipsi ان الله تعالى ظهر بصورة اشخاص ولما لم يكن بعد رسول اللــه شخص افضل من علي وبعده اولاده المخصوصون هم خيرالبرية فظهر السق بصورتهم وينطق بلسانهم واخذ بايديهم فمن هذا اطلقنا اسم الالهية عليهم Deum apparere formâ hominum quorundam; cumque non sit post Mo-hammedem

page.notes: Cap. de الخطابية [margin, beside "Esse Deum" lines]. Ibid. [margin, beside "deinde Deos."]. Arabic and Greek passages are copied as best the scan allows; words with [?] are doubtful, notably the Greek μετενσωμάτωσιν and several Arabic words in the body. The catchword at the foot right is partly obscured and may read "Mohammedem" with its first letter lost. Left edge is cropped: the first word is a fragment "stare." and is kept as such. Faint "Google" watermark at the lower right is not printed text and is left out.
